policy_terms.selected_now: part of the current staged working shape
policy_terms.explicit_opt_in: available only when the matching profile or task needs it
policy_terms.fallback_control: retained for rollback or comparison, not default
policy_terms.not_selected: known service, not part of current working shape

services.name: postgres
services.decision: keep resident as bounded transactional state

services.name: redis
services.decision: keep resident as bounded cache and coordination state

services.name: qdrant
services.decision: keep resident as vector store, bounded rather than disabled

services.name: neo4j
services.decision: keep resident as graph store with explicit heap and page cache

services.name: llama-cpp
services.decision: current Gemma 4 E2B text lane; do not force Gemma 4 through OVMS

services.name: ovms
services.decision: keep as OpenVINO embeddings seam with soft reclaim protection and owner lifecycle, not a hard memory ceiling or Gemma 4 text serving

services.name: langchain-api
services.decision: keep as canonical local agent-facing API

services.name: route-api
services.decision: keep as localhost advisory facade, not an execution service

services.name: rerank-api
services.decision: keep explicit Qwen3 OpenVINO reranker wrapper with lazy load and idle exit

services.name: rag-api
services.decision: keep lightweight RAG orchestration API over Qdrant, OVMS embeddings, route-api, rerank-api, and langchain-api

services.name: qwen-tts
services.decision: keep bounded HTTP speech surface when tools are selected; host TTS remains protected warm route

services.name: tts-router
services.decision: keep bounded speech router when tools are selected

services.name: docs-api
services.decision: keep bounded helper when tools are selected

services.name: aoa-browser
services.decision: keep bounded browser helper when tools are selected

services.name: prometheus
services.decision: keep for diagnostics with short retention and bounded query pressure

services.name: grafana
services.decision: keep dashboard service bounded when observability is selected

services.name: alertmanager
services.decision: keep bounded alert routing when observability is selected

services.name: cadvisor
services.decision: keep bounded container metrics with lower sampling cadence

services.name: loki
services.decision: keep internal-only LogQL storage for runtime log diagnosis through Grafana

services.name: tempo
services.decision: keep bounded trace backend for W3C trace-context, OTLP spans, and metric/log/span joins when observability is selected

services.name: alloy
services.decision: keep internal-only rootless Podman log ingestion into Loki instead of adding Promtail

services.name: n8n
services.decision: do not keep resident for current tasks; enable only for workflow runs

services.name: n8n-task-runners
services.decision: use external runners only with workflows, low concurrency, and idle shutdown

services.name: ollama
services.decision: retain for fallback and comparison, not current default

services.name: litellm
services.decision: retain gateway fallback, not current default

services.name: tos-graph
services.decision: enable for Tree of Sophia graph curation, not current always-on shape

services.name: babelvox-tts
services.decision: do not replace protected host TTS until hot-path latency and memory evidence improves

services.name: langchain-api-llamacpp
services.decision: keep as bounded benchmark and promotion sidecar, not default runtime
